sentences.en: One day, Chris discovered the charming girl of his dreams.
sentences.zh: 有一天，克里斯发现了他梦寐以求的那个魅力四射的女孩。

sentences.en: It was his story of adventure that charmed us all.
sentences.zh: 是他那冒险的故事让我们所有人都为之着迷。

sentences.en: Man is judged by his courage, woman by her charm.
sentences.zh: 男人靠勇气被评判，女人则靠魅力。
